lines.l: I was in first grade, just a week
I gave the other kiddies a course in Greek
At sweet sixteen I was busily employed
Explaining the theories of Sigmund Freud
Nobody taught me, I figured it out for myself
When I found out what I could mean to men
My education started all over again
It really doesn't matter if you're a top lure
Just a millionaire who loves you can make you feel secure
Nobody taught me, I figured it out for myself
I gambled in Las Vegas, broke the bank three times. I went to Hialeah, had the boogies bumming dimes. Nobody taught me, I figured it out for myself.
Well, you never get nowhere, counting on someone else
I was sued by J.P. Morgan, for control of a bank
They wanted me the verdict, I had just myself to bank
The case was well conducted, as the judge could plainly see
I would call it self-defense because the lawyer was me
Nobody taught me, I figured it out myself
Well, you never get nowhere counting on someone else
I said you never get nowhere counting on someone else
Tennis, anyone?
